originalTitle: Watch: Alaskan flying team airdrops Thanksgiving turkeys to remote communities
summary: For the last few years, the "turkey bombers" have taken to the skies for the benefit of residents in off-grid communities.
content:
For the last few years, "turkey bombers" Esther Keim and Heidi Hastings have taken to the skies to airdrop Thanksgiving turkeys to residents in off-grid communities in south-central Alaska.

Hastings pilots the plane while her best friend Keim drops the turkeys out the plane window, delivering to families who may not otherwise get one of the birds, since they are cut off by snow and ice.
chineseTitle: 观看：阿拉斯加飞行队向偏远社区空投感恩节火鸡
chineseSummary: 在过去的几年里，“火鸡轰炸机”已经飞上天空，为离网社区的居民造福。
chineseContent:
在过去的几年里，“火鸡轰炸机”埃丝特·凯姆和海蒂·黑斯廷斯一直在空中向阿拉斯加中南部离网社区的居民空投感恩节火鸡。

黑斯廷斯驾驶着这架飞机，而她最好的朋友凯姆则将火鸡从飞机窗上扔了出去，送到那些可能无法得到其中一只火鸡的家庭，因为它们被冰雪隔绝了。
